speaker: john_heminges
text: The door is shut. The boys are gone home. Cuthbert, once more, and slow enough that a clerk and a mayor can be told apart.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: A letter from my Lord Mayor to the lords of the Council. A friend had it under his eye this morning at the Guildhall, by ear from the clerk who read it over. Take it for hearsay.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: It's against plays. It names the Bankside. It speaks of the late stir and mutinous attempt, and lays that at the playhouse door. And it prays their lordships to write to the justices of Surrey to put the plays down.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: And of Middlesex.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Which of those words are the letter's, and which are the clerk's?

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: The stir, the playhouse door, Surrey, and Middlesex, I will swear to as what he heard. Whether the Theatre is named in so many words, my man could not swear.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Give me my cloak. I will walk down to Crosby Place and ask the man what my house in Shoreditch has to do with a stir on the Bankside.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Sit down, Father. You have eaten. I asked that you hear it after you had eaten, and you have. Marching on Crosby Place will only hand him a second letter.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Eighty-four! Fleetwood sent for me in 'eighty-four, and I told his man I was my Lord of Hunsdon's servant and would not come, and I did not come, and the house stood. And two years left on the ground, and he'd have me shut by the justices of Middlesex!

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item. A letter asking is not an order granted. Item, the lords must first meet and then agree, and they are at Nonsuch with the Queen, and my Lord Treasurer cannot lift a pen. Item. The— the reckoning today is thirty-three shillings a share, and I should like more Saturdays like it before any man here says tour.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Tour.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The word was scarcely out of my mouth.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A City clothworker with six weeks left in the chain, writing to be remembered. My Lord Chamberlain is not the man to let him lock out her Majesty's Christmas servants.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And if that comfort is wrong by Monday. What do we do?

speaker: james_burbage
text: I do not know. I will not dress it as knowing. I know eighty-four, and I know I did not go when I was sent for.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Love's Labour's Lost went to a good Saturday. Say the rest of it plain, now the boys are home.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No order has come. We play because no order has come, and for no better reason.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Tour is a reason, if a mayor can shut a door. I said tour. I am still saying it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: You are saying it to a room that has not agreed. Six weeks in a chain is not a statute.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thursday fortnight is the day I care for. If they shut us on the first of October I'll play him in the street.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I would have marched. I am not marching. Play him where there is a stage.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I want the boards. I will take a street before I take a silence. I have said the line, and I am not taking it back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Mayor writes of June. We are about to answer him with a play in which a king is put down.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You have said little since noon. Finish it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cut or no, I would have my lord hear of this from us before he hears it at the board.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Let him hear it from his own men, and not from a Guildhall copy read to a table of lords.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Agreed. I send to Kettleby tonight.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Middlesex is my father's house and two miles of fields. The Bankside is not the Theatre. The letter may not know the difference. We do.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Play Monday as billed.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Monday as billed. And tour, which this room may pretend it did not hear.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No talk of it at the Jackdaw. We are agreed on Kettleby, on Monday, and on that.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A room can agree. I have heard the agreement.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The reckoning today is thirty-three shillings a share. Write it as that. I will not have a good Saturday turned into a new sum.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write the share. I am not opening the coffer to look at it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Write the thirty-three. Thursday fortnight I mean to have him standing.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A letter that asks, and no order behind it. I can sit with that. I cannot sit with a march to Crosby Place.

speaker: james_burbage
text: John may have the difference for his book. I am in the room.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Nothing in the yard as we go. The boys are home. Let them stay uninformed.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book will say we play, because no order has come. It will say I send tonight. It will not say tour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cut stays out. I am not putting it back to answer a mayor.
